name: Okino Maika
source:
A girl with kind personality, she is clumsy, weak, and always makes mistakes. This has led her to being self-conscious about her inadequacies. Due to this, her efforts fail to bear fruit, and she often has to rely on her classmates and juniors.
Despite this, people appreciate her hard work and see her as a 'Klutz who wants to take care of you'.
She is highly pessimistic, and sometimes gets too depressed and shuts down.
She has a mature body and a carnal appetite appropriate to her development, so her breasts and genital are highly sensitive for a schoolgirl.
